title: Smoky Syrian Pilaf
description: A flavorful pilaf dish from Syria, with smoky notes and a hint of spice.
instructions: Heat the yellowed in a large saucepan over medium-high.
Add the smoky Syrian to the saucepan, stirring frequently.
When the rice starts to brown, add the oats, pilaf, and 2 cups of water.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 15 minutes, or until the water has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
